## Statute
§2(b)(2)(C) - "a taxpayer shall be considered as married at the close of his taxable year if his spouse (other than a spouse described in subparagraph (B)) died during the taxable year."

## Reasoning
Section 2(b)(2)(C) applies when a taxpayer's spouse died during the taxable year. The facts state that Alice died on July 9th, 2014. Since Alice died during the 2014 taxable year, Section 2(b)(2)(C) applies to Bob in 2014, meaning Bob is considered married at the close of his 2014 taxable year. The claim that Section 2(b)(2)(C) applies to Bob in 2014 is therefore true given the statute and facts.

## Answer
Answer: Entailment

§3301. Rate of tax

There is hereby imposed on every employer (as defined in section 3306(a)) for each calendar year an excise tax, with respect to having individuals in his employ, equal to 6 percent of the total wages (as defined in section 3306(b)) paid by such employer during the calendar year with respect to employment (as defined in section 3306(c)).
